description.value: Asian Garden is a Chinese and Thai restaurant in Port Alberni on Vancouver Island, offering a combined menu from two distinct Asian culinary traditions. It operates dinner-only hours most weekday and Saturday evenings, making it a useful warm-meal stop for touring cyclists arriving in town after a long day on the road. The restaurant is a locally established spot serving a community that sits along cycling routes through central Vancouver Island.
